items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I heard some good bass players, Oscar Peterson --

ctx.x: What was it that separated him from the rest of the bass players?

Well, I don't know. Well, you know, he could hear a horn or something play a different solo on his instrument, and he could turn around and play it on his bass. That's what separated him. A lot of records he'd play, you can detect a different trumpet player's solo or different guy's solo, he could do it right on the bass, you know. That's on the record. But he was the first one I heard play -- I don't think I'm wrong but he was the inspiration for Oscar, all them boys.
